title: Rice and Chickpea Pilaf with Roasted Cauliflower
subtitle: topped with toasted almonds
description: Basmati rice cooked with chickpeas, onion and carrot, served with roasted cauliflower and blanched almonds.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Blanch the cauliflower florets in boiling salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Season the cauliflower with salt and pepper, drizzle with a little olive oil and arrange on a tray lined with baking paper. Roast for about 25 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile, make the rice: sweat the chopped onion and the carrot sticks (or coarsely grated carrot) in the oil in a pot for about 5 minutes until the onion is translucent.

Add the chickpeas, rinsed and drained rice (soaked for 10 minutes), baharat and salt, then pour in the water (the chickpea cooking water works well). Bring to the boil, cover and cook for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave covered for about 10 more minutes until the rice is completely cooked.
Transfer to a serving dish, add the roasted cauliflower, scatter over the almonds and serve hot.
